name: omaTrail
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: omaTrail launches frontier survival from the Omarchy bar. Name your party, pack a wagon, set pace/rations, cross rivers, face illness, trade, and hunt wildlife. Choose original omaTrail rules or an independently built Classic 1978-inspired profile. Play either in Green Monitor or Color Deluxe graphics by keyboard or mouse. Offline only: no network, telemetry, account, daemon, or elevated access. Saves keep a backup. Design: https://gist.github.com/jeremylongshore/f6bfa2df134361ec33faa552a6df56d1

schema.label: Display mode
schema.description: Choose green-and-black phosphor graphics or the limited-color pixel palette. The selected rules and saved journey stay unchanged.

schema.label: Difficulty
schema.description: Adjust travel pressure, river risk, hunting time, and animal movement speed.

schema.label: Reduced motion
schema.description: Reduce presentation animation without changing simulation timing or game outcomes.

schema.label: Hunting aim assist
schema.description: Widen hunting targets, slow animal movement, and extend the hunting timer.
